news.titleEn: US Stock Futures Bounce After Rout, Havens Drop: Markets Wrap
news.conclusionEn: US stock futures opened sharply higher on Sunday evening, with S&P 500 contracts up about 2.1% and Nasdaq 100 contracts up 2.8%, after a seven-day losing streak pushed the S&P 500 into a correction.
news.conclusionZh: 美股期货周日晚大幅反弹，纳指期货涨约2.8%
news.whyEn: It is the first test of whether last week's AI-driven rout is exhausting itself, and sets the tone for global markets in a holiday-shortened week.
news.whyZh: 检验AI抛售潮是否见底，决定感恩节短周全球市场基调
news.detailEn: The rebound follows a week in which the S&P 500 fell for seven straight sessions and the VIX closed Friday at its highest level since April 2025. Safe havens eased: the 10-year Treasury yield slipped to about 4.94%, while spot gold rose about 1% to roughly $3,575 an ounce and Brent dipped to around $91.80. MSCI's Asia-Pacific gauge sits near bear-market territory, about 18% below its June peak. Whether futures gains hold into the cash session will show if dip buyers are back or this is just a relief bounce.
news.detailZh: 此前标普500连跌七个交易日进入回调区间，VIX恐慌指数周五收于2025年4月以来最高。避险资产方面，10年期美债收益率降至约4.94%，现货黄金涨约1%至每盎司约3575美元，布伦特原油小跌至约91.8美元。MSCI亚太指数较6月高点下跌约18%，逼近熊市。期货涨幅能否延续到正式交易时段，将显示抄底资金是否回归，还是仅为技术性反弹。

news.titleEn: Asian countries take steps to aid stock markets after AI rout
news.conclusionEn: Taiwan, South Korea and China rolled out emergency measures over the weekend, including short-selling curbs, a stabilization fund and looser margin rules, to shore up stock markets hit by the AI selloff.
news.conclusionZh: 台韩中周末密集出手救市，限制做空并放宽融资
news.whyEn: Asia's chip-heavy markets have been hit hardest by the AI rout; coordinated policy support signals how serious regulators think the damage is.
news.whyZh: 亚洲芯片股市受AI抛售冲击最重，多地同步救市说明监管层高度紧张
news.detailEn: Taiwan banned short sales below the previous close on all stocks from Monday and raised the minimum short-sale margin to 150% from 130%, after its benchmark suffered its worst week since August 1990. South Korea, whose KOSPI fell more than 5% on Friday and is down nearly 47% from its June record, readied a market stabilization fund and eased share-buyback limits. Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges cut the margin financing ratio to 80% from 100% to encourage leveraged buying. Such measures can slow selling but rarely reverse a trend unless the underlying AI earnings concerns ease.
news.detailZh: 台股基准指数录得1990年8月以来最差单周，台湾自周一起禁止所有股票以低于前一日收盘价放空，并把融券保证金比例由130%提高到150%。韩国KOSPI周五跌逾5%，较6月高点累计下跌近47%，当局准备启用股市稳定基金并放宽回购限制。沪深交易所把融资保证金比例从100%下调至80%，鼓励杠杆买入。这类措施能减缓抛压，但若AI盈利担忧不消退，很难扭转趋势。

news.titleEn: 3 big things we're watching in the market this Thanksgiving week
news.conclusionEn: Heading into Thanksgiving week, markets face Dell and HPE earnings, a wave of retail reports, and futures pricing more than 90% odds of a Fed rate hike on Dec. 9.
news.conclusionZh: 感恩节周看点：戴尔财报、零售财报及12月加息预期
news.whyEn: A near-certain Fed hike on top of the AI selloff tightens financial conditions further; Dell's results are a key read on AI server demand.
news.whyZh: AI抛售叠加美联储大概率加息，戴尔财报将检验AI服务器需求
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 ended Friday on its longest losing streak since February 2020, the Nasdaq turned negative for 2026, and all 11 sectors fell last week. HPE reports Monday after the bell and Dell on Tuesday, while Best Buy, Dick's, Kohl's and Abercrombie & Fitch report Tuesday morning ahead of Black Friday. CME FedWatch shows over 90% odds of a quarter-point hike at the Dec. 9 meeting, and Governor Christopher Waller has floated a half-point move. Markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving and at 1 p.m. ET on Friday, so thin liquidity could amplify swings.
news.detailZh: 标普500周五录得2020年2月以来最长连跌，纳指年内转跌，上周11个板块全部下跌。HPE周一盘后、戴尔周二盘后发布财报，百思买、Dick's、Kohl's和Abercrombie & Fitch周二盘前公布业绩，正值黑色星期五前夕。CME FedWatch显示12月9日加息25个基点的概率超过90%，理事沃勒甚至提出可能加息50个基点。周四感恩节休市、周五提前至美东下午1点收盘，成交清淡可能放大波动。

news.titleEn: Bahrain accuses Iran of striking industrial site as tankers hit in Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: Bahrain said an Iranian strike set fire to a civilian industrial site on Sitra Island, while two tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz and Iran claimed to have downed a US drone.
news.conclusionZh: 巴林指伊朗袭击工业设施，霍尔木兹两艘油轮遇袭
news.whyEn: Renewed attacks on Gulf infrastructure and shipping end a weeks-long lull and threaten oil supply through the world's most important energy chokepoint.
news.whyZh: 海湾设施与航运再遭袭击，威胁全球最关键石油通道的供应
news.detailEn: Residents reported smoke over Sitra Island, home to several industrial sites including a refinery run by state oil firm Bapco; Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted US facilities in Bahrain. UK maritime agency UKMTO said one tanker was struck by an unknown projectile and another was hit in its engine room, with no casualties reported. Iran also said it shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island. The escalation, part of a conflict that began with US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, keeps a risk premium in oil even as Brent trades near $92.
news.detailZh: 居民称看到锡特拉岛上空浓烟，该岛有国营巴林石油公司炼油厂等多处工业设施；伊朗革命卫队称其目标是美国在巴林的设施。英国海事机构UKMTO称一艘油轮被不明飞行物击中，另一艘机舱受损，暂无伤亡报告。伊朗还宣称在格什姆岛上空击落一架美国无人机。这场冲突始于今年2月美以对伊朗的打击，局势再度升级使油价中的风险溢价难以消退。

news.titleEn: Anthropic imposed rival non-competes, 2 a.m. sign-offs on Wall Street banks ahead of record IPO
news.conclusionEn: Citing Reuters, Fox News reported that Anthropic made unusual demands on its 22 IPO underwriters, including six-month bans on bankers working with rivals such as OpenAI.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic上市前对承销投行提出罕见苛刻要求
news.whyEn: It shows how much bargaining power top AI companies hold over Wall Street, even as Anthropic's shares slid after a record listing.
news.whyZh: 显示头部AI公司对华尔街的议价力，尽管其上市后股价下跌
news.detailEn: According to the report, Anthropic asked some banks to bar deal-team members from working with OpenAI, Cursor, DeepSeek and Hugging Face for six months. It also capped several banks' deal teams at four senior bankers and shared watermarked documents. After a law firm sent incorrect figures, Anthropic circulated a corrected filing around 2 a.m. New York time and gave banks only hours to sign off. The underwriters still earned more than half a billion dollars in fees, though the stock fell about 9% in its second session amid the broader AI selloff.
news.detailZh: 报道称，Anthropic要求部分投行禁止交易团队成员在6个月内为OpenAI、Cursor、DeepSeek和Hugging Face服务，还把多家投行的核心团队限制在4名资深银行家，并使用带水印的文件。律所发错数据后，Anthropic在纽约时间凌晨2点左右发出更正文件，只给投行几小时签字确认。承销商仍赚取超过5亿美元费用，但在AI板块抛售中，该股上市第二个交易日下跌约9%。

news.titleEn: Iran To Ration Electricity Amid Warnings Power Grid Battered by US, Israeli Strikes
news.conclusionEn: Iran began rolling power cuts of up to two hours a day and limited subsidized bread in several provinces, as President Trump said he wants a "permanent" deal with Tehran.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗开始轮流限电并限购补贴面包，民生压力加剧
news.whyEn: Energy and food shortages raise domestic pressure on Tehran and could shape whether the US pursues new strikes or a negotiated deal.
news.whyZh: 能源与粮食短缺加大伊朗国内压力，影响美伊走向谈判还是再战
news.detailEn: Iran's state electricity company said outages would last up to two hours a day depending on location, citing fuel supply problems. President Pezeshkian said attacks on gas infrastructure had worsened the situation and warned of a difficult winter. Subsidized bread has been rationed in at least three provinces, with buyers paying more than five times the price once monthly quotas run out. Trump told Fox News he wants a permanent deal, while CBS reported the US and Israel are weighing new strikes.
news.detailZh: 伊朗国家电力公司表示，因燃料供应问题，各地每天停电最长两小时。总统佩泽什基安称天然气设施遇袭令情况恶化，并警告今冬将十分艰难。至少三个省份对补贴面包实行限购，超出月度配额后价格高出五倍以上。特朗普对福克斯新闻表示希望与伊朗达成「永久」协议，而CBS报道美以正考虑新一轮打击。

news.titleEn: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warns Americans of 'bumps in the road' after tech outages
news.conclusionEn: US intelligence chief Jay Clayton warned more tech outages may follow a string of failures that grounded flights and disrupted Microsoft Outlook and bank transactions, but officials say there is no sign of a coordinated cyberattack.
news.conclusionZh: 美国情报总监警告科技故障或将持续，排除网络攻击
news.whyEn: Repeated outages in aviation, email and banking during the Thanksgiving travel rush raise questions about the resilience of critical infrastructure.
news.whyZh: 航空、邮件和银行系统接连故障，正值感恩节出行高峰，暴露关键基础设施脆弱性
news.detailEn: Speaking on CNN, Clayton said outages may continue as companies and government agencies upgrade their systems. The FAA said router upgrades caused a data flood behind a nationwide ground stop just over a week ago, while Microsoft blamed its Outlook outage on an earlier network capacity upgrade. The disruptions also slowed some bank transactions. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Americans should not worry about the security of their financial institutions.
news.detailZh: 克莱顿在CNN节目中表示，随着企业和政府升级系统，故障可能还会出现。美国联邦航空局称，一周多前导致全国航班停飞数小时的事故源于路由器升级引发的数据洪流；微软则把Outlook宕机归因于此前的网络扩容升级。这些故障还拖慢了部分银行交易。财政部长贝森特表示，民众无需担心金融机构的安全。

businessTips.explanationEn: A pre-mortem is a planning exercise where a team imagines a project has already failed and works backward to list the reasons why. Popularized by psychologist Gary Klein, it gives people permission to voice doubts that groupthink or optimism usually suppress. It surfaces risks before money and time are committed, when they are still cheap to fix.
businessTips.explanationZh: 事前验尸是一种规划练习：团队先假设项目已经失败，再倒推列出失败原因。这个方法由心理学家加里·克莱因推广，让成员敢于说出平时被乐观情绪或群体思维压下去的疑虑。它能在投入时间和资金之前发现风险，此时修正成本最低。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before launching a new service line, a manager asks everyone to spend 10 minutes writing: "It's one year later and this launch flopped — why?" The answers reveal staffing gaps and an unrealistic pricing assumption, which are fixed before launch.
businessTips.exampleZh: 上线新业务前，经理请每个人花10分钟写下：「一年后这个项目失败了，原因是什么？」大家的答案暴露出人手不足和定价假设过于乐观的问题，团队在上线前就做了调整。

businessTips.explanationEn: A loss leader is a product sold at or below cost to attract customers who then buy other, higher-margin items. Retailers lean on it heavily around Black Friday and Cyber Monday. It works only if you can reliably capture the follow-on purchase or customer relationship; otherwise you simply lose money on every sale.
businessTips.explanationZh: 引流品是指以成本价甚至亏本出售的商品，用来吸引顾客购买其他高利润产品。零售商在黑五和网一期间大量使用这一策略。前提是你能稳定拿到后续购买或客户关系，否则只是每卖一单亏一单。
businessTips.exampleEn: An online candle shop sells a sample set at cost during Black Friday but requires an email sign-up and includes a discount code for full-size candles. Repeat orders from that list over the next three months make the promotion profitable.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家线上香薰小店在黑五以成本价卖试用装，但要求留下邮箱，并附上正装折扣码。之后三个月里这批客户的复购，让这次促销整体实现盈利。

businessTips.explanationEn: Short selling means borrowing shares, selling them, and buying them back later, profiting if the price falls. Regulators sometimes restrict it during crashes — as Taiwan did this week — to slow panic selling. Research suggests bans can reduce liquidity and widen bid-ask spreads, and often fail to stop declines driven by fundamentals.
businessTips.explanationZh: 卖空是借入股票卖出、之后再买回归还，股价下跌即可获利。市场暴跌时监管机构有时会限制卖空（如本周台湾的做法）以减缓恐慌性抛售。研究显示，禁空往往会降低流动性、扩大买卖价差，而且通常挡不住由基本面驱动的下跌。
businessTips.exampleEn: If you short 100 shares at $50 and buy back at $40, you make $1,000 before borrowing fees. But if the stock rises to $70, you lose $2,000 — and losses on a short are theoretically unlimited, which is why short sellers use stop-losses.
businessTips.exampleZh: 以50美元卖空100股、在40美元买回，扣除借券费用前赚1000美元；但若股价涨到70美元，就亏2000美元。卖空的潜在亏损理论上没有上限，所以卖空者通常会设置止损。
